description: NI Packages installed with NI Package Manager (NIPM)

repository.note: NI publishes its package feeds at https://download.ni.com/, readable without authentication. Other publishers and users host their own feeds.

name_definition.note: The name is not case sensitive and shall be lowercased.

version_definition.note: The version is the package Version (e.g. 23.8.0.49349-0+f197), not the DisplayVersion.
